answer: That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Because the onyx domain is checked at the jetty verifier, the tide audit publishes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature costs the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 7 epochs later. A farm of 145 pays that 100 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
